g.text: CMU Sphinx reference: SphinxTrain job queue abstraction (the parallelism seam)
Queue: runs each job synchronously with system() as it is submitted.
So with the default queue, the NPART bw jobs run one after another.
fork per job; the child spins on kill(0, deps)
until dependencies exit, then exec. Single host only.
writes a temp script and execs qsub with -N name, -o/-e,
filesystem at identical paths on every node.
